data.title: Given Imaging recalls Bravo CF capsule delivery device, 5-pack, Product: capsule may fail to attach to the esophagus or detach from the (Class I, device)
data.summary: Capsule may fail to attach to the esophagus or detach from the delivery device. Risks include patient aspiration/inhalation, perforation of esophagus, obstruction of the airway, hemorrhage/blood loss/bleeding, laceration of the esophagus, a delay in diagnosis, and foreign bodies remaining in the patient. Product: Bravo CF capsule delivery device, 5-pack, Product Number FGS-0635, Bravo CF capsule delivery device, 1-pack, Product Number FGS-0636. Used to attach a pH monitoring capsule to the esophagus. Status: Ongoing.

https://api.fda.gov/device/enforcement.j.label: Given Imaging recalls Bravo CF capsule delivery device, 5-pack, Product: capsule may fail to attach to the esophagus or detach from the (Class I, device)

data.title: Fayus recalls OLA-OLA Pounded Yam (Iyan) IYANINSTANT, NET WT.: undeclared milk (Class I, food)
data.summary: Undeclared milk. Product: OLA-OLA Pounded Yam (Iyan) IYANINSTANT, NET WT. 2 lbs., 4 lbs., 5 lbs., 10 lbs, packed in flexible plastic bags. INGREDIENTS: Processed Dehydrated Yam Flour, freshness preserved by BHT & sodium bisulfite. UPCs: (2 lb): 650655244825, (4 lb): 650655496873, (5 lb): 650655244856, (10 lb): 650655244702 Manufacturer information is printed on the front label panel: Manufactured by: Yusol International Foods Sacramento CA 95828 www.yusolfood.com. The 10-lb bag is distributed to multiple consignees. The firm erroneously packed product for the Canadian consignee into the wrong bags printed and intended for the UK consignee, which had this manufacturing information printed on the front panel: U.K. Sole Distributor Funbel Ventures Ltd. Unit F7 Stephenson Close, Hoddesdon Hertfordshire EN11 OBW; www.funbelventures.net; info@funbelventures.net. Status: Ongoing.
